status: approved by Dimos on 9 Nov 2026; shelf prices are the Wolt prices
notes: Point costs are not written here: scripts/generate-seed.ts computes them with packages/core rewardBaseCost().
shelf_price_cents comes from data/menu.json (Wolt prices) and must be checked against in-store prices.
A 'choose any' reward is priced at the most expensive item it covers.
